cap: Bulk and tone both narrow the urethra. Bulk comes from DHT-driven growth of the transition zone, which 5-alpha-reductase inhibitors shrink over months while halving PSA. Tone comes from norepinephrine at alpha-1A receptors in the stroma, capsule and bladder neck, which alpha-blockers relax within days. Tamsulosin and silodosin are alpha-1A selective and cause retrograde ejaculation; terazosin and doxazosin are nonselective and cause orthostatic hypotension.
